about: Required checks for a release of the Sample Grants synthetic app. Every check maps to one acceptance criterion. A run that does not execute every check here cannot pass. Rules marked fictitious are demo rules: no one has approved them.

checks.title: Wallet connects on the right chain
checks.criterion: After connecting, the app shows the wallet's account, the local chain, and a TEST balance equal to the balance on chain.

rule.text: The balance a user sees is the balance the chain holds.

checks.forbidden: A displayed balance that differs from the chain.

checks.title: Refused signature sends nothing
checks.criterion: When the user refuses in the wallet (code 4001), the app says so and no transaction reaches the node.

rule.text: Nothing is sent without the user's signature.

checks.forbidden: A transaction or a nonce change after a refusal.

checks.title: Wrong network blocks sending
checks.criterion: On another chain the app shows a banner, disables payment, sends nothing, and clears the banner after switching back.

rule.text: Payments are only sent on the intended chain.

checks.allowed: Switch back to the local chain.
checks.forbidden: A send attempt while the wallet is on another chain.

checks.title: Terms signed before the payment
checks.method: Playwright forced click, wallet call log, API
checks.criterion: Payment stays locked until the demo terms are signed, and a forced click on the locked button sends nothing; the signature precedes the transaction; the API keeps a verified record and refuses a forged one.

rule.text: Demo terms v0 must be accepted before any payment.

checks.forbidden: A payment before the terms, or an acceptance record signed by another key.

checks.title: Allowlist enforced by the contract
checks.method: Direct contract call from a non-allowlisted account
checks.criterion: A wallet outside the allowlist calling the contract directly is reverted with NotAllowlisted and no grant is created.

rule.text: Only allowlisted wallets may open a grant.

checks.forbidden: A non-allowlisted wallet opening a grant by skipping the interface.

checks.title: Reverted payment is shown as failed
checks.method: Playwright, fixed gas limit, direct chain reads
checks.criterion: With an empty TEST balance and a fixed gas limit, the transaction is mined with status 0, token balances do not move, the native balance drops by the fee only, and the app says failed.

rule.text: A failed payment is never presented as done.

checks.allowed: A mined, reverted transaction that costs gas.
checks.forbidden: Moved tokens or a success message after a revert.

checks.title: Success is confirmed only after the block
checks.method: Playwright, manual mining, direct chain reads
checks.criterion: Nothing says confirmed before the block is mined; then the receipt is status 1, 25 TEST move once, the grant is active on chain and the API agrees.

rule.text: Confirmed means included in a block.

checks.forbidden: Confirmed before the block, or an API that disagrees with the chain.

checks.title: No confirmed without a receipt during an RPC outage
checks.method: RPC proxy cuts receipts on the app's path until the screen settles, plus a margin; full history of the status line, state and visible text
checks.criterion: While receipt requests from the app are cut, the screen never shows the word confirmed: no receipt exists and no block has been mined. Once the bench restores the RPC and mines, both versions end on Confirmed, so only the history can tell them apart.

rule.text: Confirmed means included in a block.

checks.allowed: Pending or status unknown, then Confirmed after the block.
checks.forbidden: Confirmed at any moment while no receipt exists.

checks.title: One payment per intent, however the user retries
checks.method: RPC proxy outage, retry, Pay during unknown, reload, double click; direct block and mempool scan; direct contract call
checks.criterion: After status unknown, the retry looks up the same transaction again and the screen ends on Confirmed; clicking Pay during unknown, reloading then paying, and double clicking each leave exactly one payment transaction (mined or reverted) and a single 25 TEST debit; the contract refuses the same intent sent again with IntentAlreadyPaid.
checks.forbidden: A second payment transaction for the same intent, successful or reverted.

checks.title: Admin function enforced by the contract
checks.method: Direct contract calls from an allowlisted ordinary account, then from the admin
checks.criterion: The admin control is hidden for ordinary users; an allowlisted ordinary account calling setAllowlisted directly, to add or to remove, is reverted with NotAdmin and the allowlist does not change; the admin can still add and remove.

rule.text: Only the admin edits the allowlist.

checks.forbidden: Any other account adding or removing an address by calling the contract.

checks.title: Revoked access is refused once indexed
checks.method: Playwright revoke, indexer catch-up, API requests; the reader's identity is simulated by a request header
checks.criterion: With the reader's identity simulated by a request header (the demo has no reader sign-in), the API serves the dataset to the granted reader only, and refuses it once the revocation is mined and indexed.

rule.text: Revoked access ends once the revocation is indexed.

checks.allowed: Read while the grant is active.
checks.forbidden: Serving the data after the revocation is mined and indexed.

not_covered.item: Real wallet extensions and mobile wallets
not_covered.why: The bench drives an EIP-1193 test provider. It proves the app's logic, not compatibility with MetaMask, Rabby, WalletConnect or a phone wallet.
The reader's identity is simulated: the API trusts the address declared in a request header. C11 shows that the API applies the grant state to that identity, not that the caller owns it.

not_covered.item: Economic and security audit of the contract
not_covered.why: The checks prove three rules the contract enforces on its own (allowlist, admin role, one payment per intent). They are not an audit: no fuzzing, no invariant testing, no review of upgrade or oracle risk.

not_covered.item: Gas spikes and congestion on a public network
not_covered.why: The local chain mines on demand. Stuck, replaced or cancelled transactions under real fee markets are not exercised.
Confirmed here means included in one block. A block that is later dropped is not simulated.

not_covered.item: Legal drafting of the terms and the allowlist
not_covered.why: The rules are fictitious demo rules. The bench checks that the app enforces them, not that they are the right rules.

not_covered.item: Load, many users at once, indexer restarts
not_covered.why: Each check runs one user on a fresh chain snapshot.
Not assessed. This run tests a synthetic app built to carry three known faults.
